name: Wayne Palmer
current_role: Assistant Secretary of Labor for Mine Safety and Health (since November 2025)
summary: Wayne Palmer heads the Mine Safety and Health Administration. He was confirmed 51–47 on October 7, 2025, in a block vote and took office on November 5, after the fall 2025 shutdown delayed swearings-in.
